description: Internet Information Services (IIS) is an extensible web server software created by Microsoft for use with the Windows NT family.

audience_guidance.student: IIS is Microsoft's web server. Misconfigurations can allow attackers to guess hidden file names or access system files.
audience_guidance.developer: Ensure custom error pages are configured to prevent stack trace leaks. Secure Web.config.
audience_guidance.bug_bounty_hunter: Test for IIS tilde (~) short name enumeration to find hidden files and directories.
audience_guidance.pentester: Check for IIS short name enumeration. Look for Web.config leaks or improper authorization via path traversal.
audience_guidance.security_team: Disable 8.3 short names on IIS servers via registry. Ensure detailed errors are only sent to localhost.
